content: Zenodo record 16780668 (Pudar, 2025, CC BY 4.0) contains Appendix_A_UT_register.csv with 4,912 real ultrasonic thickness readings across 12 water ballast tanks, 11 annual campaigns 2015-2025, columns Reading_ID/Tank/Grid_Position/Original_Scantling_mm/Measured_Thickness_mm/Measurement_Date. Verified by direct download. Enables corrosion rate, remaining life, re-inspection interval, fleet triage demo scenarios with real data. No comparable public piping CML thickness dataset exists (proprietary everywhere).
